verdict.rationale: LibreChat ships an official web app with features well beyond basic chat: a public demo at chat.librechat.ai, plus agents, MCP, memory, web search, code interpreter and scheduled chats, all in one interface. Its docs state it is a self-hosted web app, not a desktop installer, and the pack shows no official desktop or mobile apps, so the multi-surface part of the story is not met. Missing for 10: official desktop app, official mobile app, evidence of cross-surface feature parity.
